svg.title: OpenLakeForge architecture
svg.desc: Dagster launches dlt, Floe and dbt-trino. dlt lands raw CSV in the Bronze bucket, Floe validates it into Silver Iceberg tables through Polaris, and dbt-trino builds Gold marts by running SQL in Trino. Superset queries Gold through Trino. Floe and dbt-trino send OpenLineage to OpenMetadata, which crawls the catalog through Trino every hour. olf applies Terraform, which installs Helm releases on kind. Users reach the UIs through Traefik, oauth2-proxy and Dex with GitHub login.
svg.text: webserver · daemon · code server · one isolated run pod per pipeline run
then to the portal, Dagster, Superset and OpenMetadata UIs
